title: festuca ovina var. supina
intro: Festuca ovina var. supina, commonly known as Sheeps Fescue or Deer Grass, is a perennial grass species in the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving respiratory issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Festuca ovina var. supina include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
